board.name: Nomina
board.content: Nomina is an advanced strategy platform built for DeFi power users who run complex strategies across perpetual future DEXs. With Nomina, users can push more volume, synchronize opening and closing positions across exchanges, and monitor trades from all exchanges in one place. It automates the heavy lifting of alpha generation so you can grow volume while minimizing risk.
